Alger, 19 novembre 2026 (Algeria Tech) —: Algiers, November 19, 2026 (Algeria Tech) — Ooredoo awarded the prizes for the 19th edition of its Media Star competition on Monday, November 16, 2026, in Algiers. Twelve journalists were rewarded out of 164 participants for their work on the impact of artificial intelligence and 5G.
La cérémonie de remise des prix s'est te: The award ceremony was held at the Sheraton Hotel in Algiers, under the theme "The impact of artificial intelligence and 5G on socio-economic transformations in Algeria." It brought together prominent figures from the media, technology, and digital worlds. The Minister of Communication, Mohamed Bouslimani, was present to honor the winners. Roni Tohme, CEO of Ooredoo Algeria, opened the ceremony by emphasizing the importance of journalistic excellence in a context of technological shifts.
Sur 164 candidats, 12 journalistes ont é: Out of 164 candidates, 12 journalists were recognized across four categories. The jury was chaired by Mrs. Zahia Benarous. The prizes were increased for this edition: 750,000 DZD for the 1st prize, 500,000 DZD for the 2nd, and 300,000 DZD for the 3rd.
Par ce concours, Ooredoo dit vouloir pro: Through this competition, Ooredoo stated its desire to promote innovative and responsible media coverage, aligning the media with the country's digital transformations. The presence of the Minister of Communication highlights the importance given to this sector.
